answer: A farm running 164 keys hence forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. Because the ivory stake is held until the jade settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the hollow audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 46% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
